parameters.name: IpVersion
parameters.description:
The type of the private IP address to check. Valid values:

- **ipv4**: IPv4. This parameter is optional when the private IP address is of the IPv4 type.
- **ipv6**: IPv6. This parameter is required when the private IP address is of the IPv6 type.

parameters.name: PrivateIpAddress
parameters.description: The private IP address to check. The private IP address must belong to the vSwitch specified by the **VSwitchId** parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the vSwitch to which the private IP address belongs.

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) to obtain the region ID.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the vSwitch to which the private IP address belongs.
